snippet.title: Lighthold Official Trailer | Cozy Lighthouse Tower Defense
snippet.description:
Grow your light by day, burn the shadows by night. Lighthold is coming to Steam, wishlist it now!

Lighthold is a cozy lighthouse tower defense game. You are the keeper of the last lighthouse, and every night shadows climb out of the sea and head straight for your tower. Your one weapon? A really, really big flashlight. Point it at them and watch them melt.

By day, spend your Lumen on upgrade trees for the Lighthouse, the Clock Tower, the Dock, the Hut and a treasure chest that is definitely not trying to eat you. Peek at the Tree of Darkness to see what wakes up tomorrow night.

You won't be alone out there. Bits (a small cookie monster with a fishing lure on his head) bites shadows for a living, and the owl spots the sneaky ones. And some nights, the New Moon Lord shows up with a bell. Be worried about the bell.

• Short, punchy nights and a chill day phase
• Lots of upgrades across a bunch of skill trees
• Companions: Bits, a loyal lantern dog and an owl that sees everything
• 27 languages (yes, we counted)

A wishlist is the nicest thing you can give a tiny lighthouse. 🔦

00:42 Boss fight: the New Moon Lord
